row_fix.program: Other funding options (Request for proposals windows: Enhancing Direct Access, REDD+ RBP); project approval / SAP / PPF are open-ended routes
row_fix.reason: Homepage is not a funding listing; this page lists the live RFP windows with their status (Request for proposals active / ended).

summary: GCF has no machine-readable feed of live funding calls with deadlines. The only live call is the Enhancing Direct Access RFP, shown as 'Request for proposals active' on an HTML page with no deadline. The Project approval, SAP and PPF routes are open-ended, so there is no date to extract. The html adapter can watch the windows page for status changes. It cannot create opportunity rows. The Drupal portfolio fragment that exposes plain JSON is real and stable, but it lists approved and under-implementation projects, not opportunities, so it is not a funding feed for SALSAV.

json_candidate_rejected.why: Top-level JSON has results_html (an HTML string) instead of an item array, so json_api items_path cannot reach the cards. Even a parser would return approved projects, not opportunities.

engine_requirements: No new adapter is recommended for opportunities. Keep the html adapter on https://www.greenclimate.fund/access-funding/other-funding-options so status changes to the RFP windows are detected. Optional, not for the opportunities table: a new json_api-style parser for https://www.greenclimate.fund/gcf/fragments/projects-browse, which needs to parse results_html (card a[href^=/portfolio/projects/fp] and p.f-body-bold for the title) to build a funded-precedent list. Plain HTTP, no key, no pagination needed for round 1.
